name: Raster Occlusion Culling
aliases: Raster Occlusion Culling for Dense Volume Data
definition: A technique to determine the visibility of scene objects (specifically voxel blocks) by replacing expensive individual hardware occlusion queries with a single efficient proxy geometry rasterization pass followed by GPU-driven stream compaction to create a dense list of occupied subvolumes.
summary: Raster Occlusion Culling determines voxel block visibility by rasterizing efficient proxy geometry instead of using hardware occlusion queries or hierarchical depth maps.
